node.statement: The opening clause of node 1.2 now binds P_jq(Y) explicitly by the same finite double-sum formula used in node 1.1. Therefore every occurrence of P_jq(Y) in nodes 1.2.1--1.2.3 is in scope from its ancestor 1.2, and node 1.3 combines the estimates of nodes 1.1 and 1.2 for one and the same explicitly defined operator P_jq(Y).
